verdict.rationale: The Ryzen AI Max+ 395 ships with a first-party software ecosystem (Ryzen AI Software, the Lemonade SDK and server interface, and the GAIA agent framework), so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. However, no evidence item mentions an MCP server. The LLM server interface for multi-language app integration and the GAIA agent-building framework are different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
